<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex023012026-09-1501-08-22" status="unreviewed"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3827">'broM</rs> na re rnam pa ni sargyas dang ing lo skyes pa'i mkhyen 3 gyi se+es kyi bye brag smo || 
deg rang gi dran po lter bzhag asa pa'i shes pa tha mi dad par rlom ste rnam pa gos par bya ba yin des na yuM gyi la 'di hyi kyi theg pa nzhan pang la nye ba yin te 'brus lar du byed pa'i phyor || so so skye bo la zhags ral pas lhob
<lb edRef="inst:4638" n="N006"/>
hes snoM par thal zhe na ma sni ste sru brel na dri madag pa'i yid la brten pa zhes pa dang rgyu bla ma nas dang sug dpes de la zag Na yod par bshod ces || sbyor ba ni gzhi dang la na rnaM pa skya bcal argnas pa mkhyan gr gyi sbyor ba smoM zoro | rnam pa dang sbyor ba tha dad du sgo pa de ni mi rigs te sbyor ba khyad par can dag gi snanM pa rnas go dgos na zhes bshad pa'i phyir || <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3827">'brom</rs> gyi de yang mi 'thede gsan sngags pa'i chos skad bcug pa sming zhing gzhung gi dag ni rigs yod
<lb edRef="inst:4638" n="N007"/>
pa la dgogs pa yin | </seg></TEI>
